title: Meet Joaquin
body: Joaquin works every PIP claim for a 4-clinic injury practice, from submission to payment or handoff. Here is his Monday before and after this tracker.

title: Every claim in one list
body: Carrier, date of service, billed and paid amounts, benefits used and status for every PIP claim, newest first. Click a row to open the claim.

title: The claim history
body: Each submission, EOB, adjuster call and payment in order, with the next follow-up date, so nothing depends on memory.

title: An exhaustion notice that does not add up
body: The carrier says benefits are used up on claim 5208, but its own payments total $8,140 of a $10,000 limit. The tracker flags it instead of passing it to the LOP side.

title: Days left to dispute
body: The countdown shows how long until the appeal deadline, so the claim closest to being lost is worked first.

title: Joaquin approves, then the adjuster hears
body: No reconsideration goes to a carrier and no balance moves to the LOP coordinator until Joaquin approves it.

title: How billing is doing
body: First-pass acceptance, deadlines this week, A/R over 90 days and LOP handoffs, worked out from the claims themselves.

title: What this work costs today
body: Put in your own claim volume and billing rate to compare today's cost with the tracker.

title: How it would be built
body: Click any box to see what it does, what data passes through it and whether it stores patient data. EOBs come in from the clearinghouse and carrier portals; a real build runs in the practice's own cloud.
